items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and authorize no spend, billing changes, money movement, or monetization expansion. Amazon evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; the $4.92 cannot be assigned to sites because it is in Amazon's aggregate "other" row. AI usage is $945.247 from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-29 across 5,264 calls and 39 instrumented sites, with 229 errors, but it is not period-matched to the single revenue day. Contribution margin, infrastructure spend, budget exposure, ROI, payback, forecasts, cost-to-learn, and causal lift are unknown because allocated costs, budgets, matching-period revenue, and approved learning thresholds are unavailable. Continue only the existing period-aligned finance reconciliation, deployed-work measurement, repair containment, security evidence, and private launch-gate work. Do not retain the proposed CRO experiments or prototype as finance-approved proposals this cycle; active delivery is already 10/10 slots and financial evidence does not support expansion.

Minimum evidence required for a calculable financial review is a dated ledger matching each revenue item and cost item to the same site or content identifier and period, including AI, infrastructure, domains, and other operating costs, plus an approved dollar learning threshold and measurement window. Until then, report aggregate revenue and AI spend separately without calculating margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, or forecasts.
